title: M5Stack StackChan · K151
summary: ESP32-S3交互机器人，CoreS3触摸屏、双舵机、三分区触摸板和12颗RGB；模型复用官方结构件与CoreS3前部，未知PCB布局保留明确占位。

facts.label: Main Controller
facts.value: ESP32-S3; Xtensa® dual-core 32-bit LX7, 240 MHz; 16MB Flash, 8MB Quad PSRAM

facts.label: Wireless Connectivity
facts.value: 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi, IEEE 802.11 b/g/n; Bluetooth® 5 LE; Infrared receiver IRM56384 + infrared transmitter

facts.label: Wired Connectivity
facts.value: USB CDC & full-speed USB OTG; GPIO, UART, I2C

facts.label: Display
facts.value: 2.0-inch IPS LCD, resolution 320*240, 65536 colors, ILI9342C / ILI9342E driver; Capacitive multi-touch, FT6336U driver

facts.label: Sensors
facts.value: Dual microphones, ES7210 audio codec; Proximity & ambient light sensor LTR-553ALS-WA; 9-axis IMU BMI270 + BMM150 (accelerometer + gyroscope + magnetometer); Three-zone touch panel, Si12T driver; Full-featured NFC ST25R3916

facts.label: Human Interactions
facts.value: 1W speaker, AW88298 16-bit I2S power amplifier; RGB LEDs WS2812C * 12; Power and reset buttons; Power indicator LED

facts.label: Expansions
facts.value: microSD card slot; Grove interface * 3; LEGO®-compatible mounting holes

facts.label: Motors
facts.value: 360-degree horizontal servo with feedback; 90-degree vertical servo with feedback

facts.label: Power
facts.value: 550 mAh battery; USB-C power and data; Power management IC AXP2101, RTC BM8563

facts.label: Package Size
facts.value: StackChan: 142.0 x 101.0 x 58.0mm; StackChan Remote: 155.0 x 109.0 x 65.0mm

rows: LCD driver changed from ILI9342C to ILI9342E

facts.label: SCSCL feedback servo bus
facts.notes: BSP defaults; individual physical devices can store different calibrated zero positions in NVS.

facts.label: PY32 RGB command path
facts.notes: RGB output is generated by the PY32 controller, not by an ESP32-S3 RMT pin. Serial-chain order does not prove physical LED placement.

facts.label: SCSCL position command and torque
facts.notes: Writing the goal position automatically engages torque. This is distinct from switching VM_EN off; physical calibration and load behavior remain unverified.

facts.label: CoreS3 front assembly and StackChan envelope
facts.method: Retain manufacturer STL triangles and native millimetres; assemble the CoreS3 head rear plane at z=22.6532 using its source rear z=0.25. Measure width/height/head depth on the selected shell parts. tools/rebuild-product-model.py build m5stack-k151 reproduces geometry; detail-dimensions-verification.json records all 15 checks. Servo envelope follows the SCS0009 dimension drawing.
facts.notes: Glass display offset is excluded from nominal head depth. Optical depths/materials, battery geometry, PCB outlines/placement and touch electrode geometry are estimates. The rectangular servo mounting-ear approximation retains a 0.55 mm fit residual. Photo checks are qualitative; no physical fit or movement-direction calibration.

2026-11-01: audited StackChan K151 host, base touch/RGB and feedback-servo protocols. Historical sources retained. Fetch identities and factory/UIFlow2/XiaoZhi investigation: docs/platform/research/stackchan-runtime-sources-2026-11-01.json. Hardware facts do not imply complete simulator compatibility.

VM_EN off feedback conflict: manufacturer schematics show only the gated VM supply at the three-wire servo; upstream Xiaozhi K151 README reports feedback while motor power is off. Current ideal model excludes unverified signal back-power; no physical-device claim. Full conflict and higher-precision fetch timestamps are retained in the runtime source audit.

2026-11-01: official SCSCL goal-write auto torque enable and power-on torque=0 checked against FEETECH memory table; source receipts: docs/platform/research/stackchan-servo-torque-sources-2026-11-01.json. Factory Servo Test now separately exercises actual mechanical movement, rather than its timed completion page alone.

2026-11-02: model assembly now includes all ten official K151 printed parts, the reusable K128 CoreS3 front, visible terminals/optics, SCS0009 servo envelopes, RGB packages, screws and photo-derived labels. Five neutral UNKNOWN PCB layers and estimated battery geometry remain partial. See docs/platform/models/m5stack-k151.md and detail-source-receipts.json for source reuse/refetch timestamps and retained limitations. Factory V1.5.1 App Setup Next is verified through virtual VHCI; this does not model physical radio pairing.

2026-11-02 RGB fit follow-up: the previous separate rectangular light cells protruded beyond the source guide surface and front end. They are replaced by six source-triangle partitions on each original curved guide crown. Guide placement is corrected from independent shell/guide circle fits; estimated LED packages no longer intersect the guide in sampled sections. See rgb-fit-review.json and docs/platform/evidence/m5stack-k151/runtime/rgb-surfaces-browser.json. Physical LED order, optical diffusion and actual PCB placement remain uncalibrated.
